name: tedtoolkit-communication
description: Audience-aware communication drafts grounded in supplied facts, starting with humble technical inquiries and feedback.

interface.longDescription: Turn technical findings and communication goals into concise messages for colleagues, maintainers, and vendors. Ask about the sender's usage and understanding first while preserving observed facts and making the requested help clear.
defaultPrompt: Help me draft a humble technical inquiry from these findings and ask whether my usage or understanding needs adjustment.
